summary: Reconnect an interrupted Quick access follow on explicit Refresh without replaying edits

replay.detail: No stored claims, membership winners or history are rewritten.

schema.detail: The existing shared follow interface and server contracts are unchanged.

rules.detail: Existing ownership, lifecycle and reader-readiness checks remain in force.

compatibility.detail: Refresh keeps its Promise-returning interface. Reconnection rediscovers current capabilities and preserves known retirement.

manual.detail: An explicit Refresh reopens an interrupted follow. There is no automatic reconnect or edit resend; unresolved edits must settle before replacement.

recovery.detail: Late events from a replaced session are ignored. Last-known rows remain while reconnecting; a failed reconnect stays explicitly unavailable.
